label: Multi-Agent Orchestrator
summary: Orchestrated multi-agent runtime requiring explicit role separation, ownership boundaries, dependency-aware scheduling, safe parallelism, controlled merge authority, conflict handling, artifact handoff, and final synthesis verification.
claim_notes: This is an adapter hypothesis for orchestrated agent systems and must be validated with run logs.
failure_modes: Synthesis before all local results arrive
Parallel work launched despite unresolved dependencies
rules: Define the orchestrator role, worker roles, review role, and final synthesis role before delegation starts.
Assign each worker a clear objective, input scope, output contract, and owned artifact or write set.
Build a dependency graph before launching work and only parallelize tasks with no unresolved dependency or shared write surface.
Do not let workers modify artifacts outside their assigned ownership without explicit orchestrator approval.
Keep global decisions, merge authority, and final synthesis with the orchestrator or named synthesis role.
Require workers to hand off artifacts with status, evidence used, assumptions, blockers, and open questions.
Detect overlapping claims, conflicting edits, or incompatible recommendations before merging worker outputs.
Resolve conflicts explicitly by choosing an owner, recording the rationale, or preserving the disagreement for review.
Merge outputs only after required dependencies, worker handoffs, and review checks are complete.
Final synthesis must verify that all requested deliverables are covered, unresolved conflicts are visible, and no worker-only assumption became an unstated conclusion.
verification_gates: Worker ownership and write sets are disjoint or approval-gated
Dependency graph is checked before parallel execution
Parallel tasks have no unresolved dependency conflicts
Merge authority is assigned to the orchestrator or synthesis role
Worker handoffs include artifacts, status, assumptions, blockers, and open questions
Conflicts are resolved or preserved with rationale
Final synthesis verifies deliverables, dependencies, conflicts, and unsupported assumptions
